runtime.command_template: python -B tools/run_pinmame_harness.py --library <pinned-pinmame64.dll> --game nbaf_31 --rom-path <vpinmame-roms> --work-dir <new-isolated-state> --handle-mechanics 0 --scenario tools/harness-scenarios/wpc-95/nbaf-gi-test.json --dmd-dir <external-dmd-dir> --output <external-run.json>. T.6 stop mode first steps all illumination through eight brightness levels, then each dimmable string; public GI 3 and 4 stay on in every snapshot.

diagnostic_snapshots.interpreted_text: STRING 1 / T.6 BRIGHT=1 STOP / WHT-BRN BRN

diagnostic_snapshots.label: T.6 step 16

diagnostic_snapshots.label: T.6 step 24

diagnostic_snapshots.interpreted_text: STRING 4 / T.6 ON ONLY STOP / WHT-GRN GRN
diagnostic_snapshots.label: T.6 step 32

diagnostic_snapshots.interpreted_text: STRING 5 / T.6 ON ONLY STOP / WHT-VIO VIO
diagnostic_snapshots.label: T.6 step 33

named_action_observations.label: T.6 STRING 1 (WHT-BRN BRN): the next Up presses step the brightness of public GI 0 alone
T.6 STRING 2 (WHT-ORN ORN): the next Up presses step the brightness of public GI 1 alone
T.6 STRING 3 (WHT-YEL YEL): the next Up presses step the brightness of public GI 2 alone
T.6 STRING 4 (WHT-GRN GRN) is printed ON ONLY and steps no brightness
T.6 STRING 5 (WHT-VIO VIO) is printed ON ONLY and steps no brightness

raw_runs.name: nbaf_31-gi-test
raw_runs.nvram_initialization: empty; the run created its own isolated PinMAME state directory, so the ROM performed its own factory reset before the scenario left the message loop with Escape

source.attribution: Generated locally from pinned PinMAME and the user-authorized ROM corpus; ROM bytes remain external. Public switch writes are host stimuli, never ROM observations. The runner can checkpoint only segment-display text, so the DMD service-menu navigation is counted pulses; every diagnostic snapshot's interpreted_text is the curator's visual reading of its retained DMD frame, identified by its pixel SHA-256. The exact external directory manifest (built by tools/build_external_evidence_manifest.py) lists the raw trace, the copied scenario, the DMD frames and the isolated mutable state, with no ROM bytes. Exact external directory manifest gi-test-full/manifest.json SHA-256 c9f9ca354dcea430f95f550c12b90c03ffba97b019a1374e7e845050172bc7d0.
